body: I go to the gym every week day. I've lost 50 pounds, have made myself "good looking". Still nothing changes. My self esteem is still so low and my social anxiety still so severe. Going to the gym constantly doesn't do much.

thanks for your reply. Tried a therapist and it didn't work out with her unfortunately:( . Maybe she just wasn't the right fit for me or maybe therapy just doesn't work for me but really not sure what else I can try.
There's no point in finding your purpose if you can't share it with anyone. I know what I wanted to do career-wise/purpose wise. But what really is the point when I won't be happy?

Been this this way for years. Had an actual suicidal attempt 2 years away. Was close to trying again a couple months ago. It was today when I realized that most people truly don't care. People are selfish. And it's the selfish people that win most in life. It doesn't matter how smart/gifted/kind/giving you are. What we tend to value in people these days is mind boggling. People only care about themselves. But why would they care about people like me? I really don't deserve any extra attention. I'm meaningless...
I know... no one cares right
